text:
andrea: Quick sync — optimize toolkit rollout readiness. tagging owners: @mike (quant), @sana (batching), @jorge (canary). can we run a quick checklist before canary?

mike: pushed quant recs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/pull/432 — uses groupwise int8 + per-channel scaling. perf looks solid on g4dn. needs runtime review.

sana: batch/caching suggestions live in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/batching-caching.md — main recs: dynamic batching window 50ms, prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. dry-run with shadow traffic: CPU down ~12%.

liz: can you paste the config snippet so infra can validate SLOs?

sana: ```
batch:
  window_ms: 50
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_ms: 300000
```

owen: fyi, regression alert from @eva's eval harness: ROUGE dropped ~2% on summarization when using the int8 per-tensor path in one runner. run id: 2026-03-15-21. we should gate auto-rollout.

mike: noted. that was the per-tensor path. groupwise int8 is the intended path and didn't show the drop. i'll add an eval guard in CI to fail if ROUGE drop > 1.5%.

andrea: ownership recap: mike owns quant rollout, sana owns batching config, jorge owns canary infra & probes. who will triage this regression?

eva: i'll triage with a bisect job tomorrow morning and post results here. can we delay auto-rollout until we confirm root cause?

jorge: canary plan: stage to 5% traffic, health probes every 30s, compare p50/p99 and quality probes. @deploy-bot can you start canary once we have a green sign-off?

deploy-bot: deploy started — canary 5% for pr-432 on prod-aws-us-east-1 (canary_ts:2187654500)

mike: quick CR ping to @eng-runtime — please review the kernel selection tweak in the PR diff, small change in qkv op ordering.

owen: reviewing now, will focus on seq_len edge-cases and perf counters.

liz: cost estimate: caching + quant together -> ~8% token-cost reduction in these workload sims.

sana: i'll update the optimize-toolkit runbook with fallback policy: if eval drift > 1.5% revert to float16 snapshot and block auto-promote.

andrea: timeline check — mike, ETA for final fixes and merging?

mike: aiming for final review + merge by EOD PST. if we miss, canary slips to next Tue.

eva: bisect job kicked off (job-987). will report delta slices and suspect commit.

owen: lgtm on kernel change, left a small comment about seq_len < 32 case.

mike: addressed the comment and pushed a fix.

deploy-bot: canary health OK at 1h — 200/200 probes green, latency within SLOs, no error spike.

andrea: thanks all. i will update the roadmap checkpoint and mark the rollout as "canary-in-progress". please keep posting eval updates here. :thumbsup:
